instruction.text: An open book is 20.8 centimetres wide and has a diagonal length of 24.1 centimetres. What is the height of the book? Give your answer to two decimal places.
A computer screen is 29.6 centimetres wide and has a diagonal length of 35.3 centimetres. What is the height of the computer screen? Give your answer to two decimal places.
A piece of metal is 1.5 metres long and has a diagonal length of 1.9 metres. What is the width of the piece of metal? Give your answer to two decimal places.
A lorry is 20.9 feet long and has a diagonal length of 23.8 feet. What is the height of the lorry? Give your answer to two decimal places.
